rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Item dated 10 May 2000, 14:40: Vladimir Putin sent State Duma Chairman Gennady Seleznev (printed 'Геннадию Селезневу', dative) a letter submitting Mikhail Kasyanov's candidacy for the Duma's consent to his appointment as Chairman of the Government under Article 83 of the Constitution.

bounded_scope: Chairman of the Government observations for CLAUDE-C01-19 only. Nomination, presentation at a sitting, parliamentary consent, approval or refusal, votes, appointment, the Government's resignation, dismissal or laying down of powers, continued duties, acting service and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The presidency roles of CLAUDE-C01-05 and C01-14 and the USSR packet are outside this extract.
